title: University of Manchester Campus Tour | Explore Iconic Spots and Student Life
description:
Welcome to the University of Manchester! Join us as we explore some of the most iconic spots on our vibrant campus. Whether you're a prospective student or just curious about our university, this tour gives you a glimpse into the places where history meets modern student life. For a more detailed look, you can access the campus map here: https://personalpages.manchester.ac.uk/staff/p.dudek/travel/campus_map.pdf

 00:00 Intro

1. 00:19 The Iconic Arch 
Location: Oxford Road, M13 9PL 

 

2. 00:44 Whitworth Hall 
Stunning Gothic architecture and the grand stage for graduation ceremonies. 
Location: Oxford Road, M13 9PL 
Opening Hours: Mon-Fri, 9 AM - 5 PM (Check for event closures) 

 
3. 01:24 Alan Gilbert Learning Commons 
A 24/7 study space with modern amenities. 
Location: 5 Bridgeford Street, M13 9PL 
Opening Hours: Open 24/7  
(Check for maintenance updates here: https://www.library.manchester.ac.uk/locations-and-opening-hours/learning-commons/) 

 
4. 01:58 The Main Library 
Historic and modern blend, housing over 4 million books. 
Location: Oxford Road, M13 9PP 
Opening Hours:  
Mon-Fri, 8 AM - 8 PM  
Weekends: 9 AM – 5 PM 
(Check for updated time here:  
https://www.library.manchester.ac.uk/locations-and-opening-hours/main-library/) 

 

5. 02:37 Samuel Alexander Building 
Home to the School of Arts, Languages, and Cultures with a unique mix of old and new architecture. 
Location: Oxford Road, M13 9PL 
Opening Hours:  
Mon-Fri, 9 AM - 5 PM (Check for access updates) 

 

6. 03:25 Students' Union Building 
The heart of student life with endless activities and opportunities. 
Location: Oxford Road, M13 9PR 
Opening Hours:  
Term time 
Monday - Friday: 8 AM - 10:30 PM 
Saturday: 9 AM - 10:30 PM 
Sunday: 12 PM - 10:30 PM 
Out of term-time 
Monday - Friday: 8 AM – 6 PM 
(Many drop-in student services close between 4 and 5pm.) 
Weekends: Closed 
(Check for updated time here: https://manchesterstudentsunion.com/opening-times) 

Want to know more about our Students’ Union? Check our previous video here! https://youtu.be/qIWMa07JQaE?si=qJ3k2Aiah8JX9nOm 

 
What’s your favourite building on campus? Share it in the comment below! 
See you soon on campus! 🎓✨

title: University of Waterloo - Faculty of Engineering Guided Walking Tour
description:
Welcome to The University of Waterloo's Faculty of Engineering, Canada's largest Engineering school! 
Ranked among the top 50 engineering schools worldwide, Waterloo Engineering is known for its world-renowned and ground breaking technologies and facilities that are readily available to our students. 
Take a virtual walk around our engineering buildings and facilities in our wonderful Waterloo campus guided by an Engineering student ambassador.

Find out more: https://uwaterloo.ca/engineering/

Twitter: https://twitter.com/WaterlooENG
